symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the ambient label space, $m=h^3=10^6$.
symbols.quote: Nested subspace labels give each vertex (source, gate or sink) of the [exchange network](exchange-network.md) a subspace of an $m$-dimensional space, nested along every edge.

symbols.name: number of smaller calls
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls that the edges of the network cost.
symbols.quote: They choose the frames of [Frames on wire arrays](array-frames.md) so that $s$, the total number of smaller calls, is below $Wm$, where $W$ is the number of wires.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the network under consideration.
symbols.quote: They choose the frames of [Frames on wire arrays](array-frames.md) so that $s$, the total number of smaller calls, is below $Wm$, where $W$ is the number of wires.

symbols.name: ground-set size
symbols.meaning: The size of the ground set whose three-element subsets index the network, $h=100$.
symbols.quote: With $h=100$ the size of the ground set whose three-element subsets (*triples*) index the network, bit labels live in $F=\mathbb Q^h$ and complex labels in $F=\mathbb F_2^h$.

symbols.name: label field space
symbols.meaning: The space $\mathbb Q^h$ (bit network) or $\mathbb F_2^h$ (complex network) in which the one-coordinate labels live.
symbols.quote: With $h=100$ the size of the ground set whose three-element subsets (*triples*) index the network, bit labels live in $F=\mathbb Q^h$ and complex labels in $F=\mathbb F_2^h$.

symbols.name: triple indicator
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector in $F$ of a triple $T$.
symbols.quote: For a triple $T$, $t_T$ is its indicator vector.

symbols.name: ambient label space
symbols.meaning: The space $F^{\otimes3}$ of $h\times h\times h$ arrays, of dimension $m$, in which all labels lie.
symbols.quote: $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$, of dimension $m=h^3$, is the space of $h\times h\times h$ arrays: $x\otimes y\otimes z$ has entries $x_iy_kz_l$, forms multiply factorwise, and $\dim(U\otimes V)=\dim U\dim V$.

symbols.name: bank size
symbols.meaning: The number of index tuples $a$, so the number of wires in each data bank.
symbols.quote: Data wires $X_a,Y_a$ are indexed by tuples $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ of triples, and $N$ is the number of such tuples.

symbols.name: terminal line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}$, the source label of $X_a$.
symbols.quote: With $U_a=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$, the terminal labels are

symbols.name: total dimension loss
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges.
symbols.quote: If decreasing edges lose $L$ dimensions in total, absolute changes sum to $Wm-2N+2L$, so the saving rests on keeping $L$ small.

symbols.name: stage number
symbols.meaning: The stage, 1, 2 or 3, whose invocations vary coordinate $a_j$.
symbols.quote: At stage $j$, invocations vary $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\cap A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars: $B=0$ at stage $1$).

symbols.name: earlier factor space
symbols.meaning: The tensor product $F^{\otimes(j-1)}$ of the factors already exposed at stage $j$.
symbols.quote: At stage $j$, invocations vary $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\cap A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars: $B=0$ at stage $1$).

symbols.name: earlier tensor line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}$ inside $A$.
symbols.quote: At stage $j$, invocations vary $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\cap A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars: $B=0$ at stage $1$).

symbols.name: complement of P
symbols.quote: At stage $j$, invocations vary $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\cap A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars: $B=0$ at stage $1$).

symbols.name: later tensor line
symbols.quote: At stage $j$, invocations vary $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\cap A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars: $B=0$ at stage $1$).

symbols.name: invocation count
symbols.meaning: The number of invocations over the three stages.
symbols.quote: With $I$ invocations of $\gamma$ central wires each, $L=I\gamma h$.

symbols.name: central wires per invocation
symbols.meaning: The number of central wires in each invocation, 100 (bit) or 101 (complex).
symbols.quote: With $I$ invocations of $\gamma$ central wires each, $L=I\gamma h$.

symbols.name: projection onto a label
symbols.meaning: The projection onto the label $U$ along $U^\perp$, the matrix assigned to a gate or sink labelled $U$.
symbols.quote: In the bit network each vertex gets a rational $m\times m$ matrix: $\Pi_U$, the projection onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, at a gate or sink labelled $U$; $-\Pi_{U_a}$ at $X_a$'s source; $0$ at other sources.

derivations.quote: As $t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T=|S\cap T|$ and $\sum_i(t_T)_i=3$, $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-1$, while $t_S\cdot t_T=|S\cap T|\bmod 2$. So $\langle t_T,t_T\rangle\in\{2,1\}$: each line $\langle t_T\rangle$ is *nondegenerate* (the form stays nondegenerate on it, so $F=\langle t_T\rangle\perp t_T^\perp$), and neighbouring triples, meeting in $1$ element (bit) or $0$ or $2$ (complex), have orthogonal indicators.
Source dimensions sum to $N$, sink dimensions to $Nm+N(m-1)+(W-2N)m=Wm-N$.
Each gate's wires carry its label on both sides, so signed changes telescope along wires to $Wm-2N$ in total.

With $A'=A\otimes F$, $B'=(P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle)^\perp_{A'}$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$, the outputs are $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ and $B'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$, stage $j+1$'s inputs; stage $1$ starts at $U_a$, $0$ and stage $3$ ends at $\mathcal F$, $U_a^\perp$.

Splitting $A=B\perp P$ and $F=\langle t_T\rangle\perp t_T^\perp$, every arrow is a growing inclusion except centre $3\to4$, which drops $P\otimes F$, of dimension $h$; side $2\to5$ needs $t_X\perp t_Y$.

Splitting $A=B\perp P$ and $F=\langle t_T\rangle\perp t_T^\perp$, every arrow is a growing inclusion except centre $3\to4$, which drops $P\otimes F$, of dimension $h$; side $2\to5$ needs $t_X\perp t_Y$. With $I$ invocations of $\gamma$ central wires each, $L=I\gamma h$.
As $I=3\binom h3^2$ and $N=\binom h3^3$, $L/N=3\gamma h/\binom h3$, below $1/2$ for $\gamma=100$ (bit) and $\gamma=101$ (complex).

For $U\subset V$, $\Pi_V-\Pi_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero on $U\perp V^\perp$, so has rank $\dim V-\dim U$, either way round. Only $X_a$'s first edge differs: its gate has label $U_a$, giving $2\Pi_{U_a}$, of rank one with no dimension change.
